_note: Xenon community gallery catalog. Rendered by docs/index.html and served to the app via GET /api/community/catalog. Entries are moderated: submit yours with a PR (see README.md in this folder). Every field is re-validated by the app before display, and installing always goes through the normal import preview. Entries with a 'limited' block are limited-edition drops: reservation-only (via Discord), carry no code, and set total/claimed copies — claimed>=total is sold out.

entries.name: DGM Telemetry
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Telemetry is a responsive system-monitoring widget for Xenon. Standard Mode shows CPU, GPU, memory and storage through the official system stream. An optional external bridge adds compatible FPS, frametime, precise sensors, coolant, pump RPM and drive health.

entries.name: DGM Personal Training
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Personal Training is a responsive monthly workout calendar for Xenon. Create, edit and delete training sessions by day, navigate between months and keep the plan locally through Xenon’s official storage. It supports Spanish and English and requires no network connection.

entries.name: DGM Personal Exercise
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Personal Records is an editable strength-tracking widget for Xenon. Record exercise names and personal bests in kilograms, update or remove entries and keep the data locally through Xenon’s official storage. It supports Spanish and English and makes no network requests.

entries.name: Codex
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A herbarium you tend. Sow a specimen, let it grow in your real local weather, then hold the press and release inside the ink window. Each plate is engraved from its own seed and given a Latin name. Tap to open the codex full screen, and cross two plates to find new species.

entries.name: Abisso
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: The deep ocean at night: jellyfish and marine snow in the backdrop, a calm Ambient clock, and the Dive widget where CPU load becomes dive depth. Descend from sunlight to the hadal zone, meet the anglerfish under heavy load, and a hydrothermal vent ignites when the CPU runs hot.

entries.name: Lakeside
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A painted mountain lake that follows the real world: the season turns with the calendar and the sun and moon cross the sky at your actual sunrise and sunset. The matching Ambient scene ships as its own entry, Lakeside Scene.

entries.name: Notte Stellata
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: An impasto night sky in the spirit of Van Gogh. The stars and swirls really move, the widget paints CPU, GPU and temperature as brushstrokes, and the Ambient scene shows only the time, the weather and what is playing.
entries.changelog: 1.0.0: the theme, the animated impasto background, the system widget and the Ambient scene, in ten languages.

entries.name: Kintsugi
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: Dark urushi lacquer mended with veins of gold, inspired by Japanese kintsugi. Ships a light and a dark palette, an animated golden-seams background and a matching Ambient clock scene.

entries.name: Limnograph
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A 1970s alpine field station built around a mountain-lake photograph. Frosted survey panels, slow natural water refraction, and a fullscreen Ambient logbook with local time and live weather.
entries.changelog: Removed the artificial survey lines and moving scan from both the dashboard background and Ambient scene. The lake now moves only through subtle natural refraction.

entries.name: Afterimage
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: An early-2000s night-city desktop for Xenon. Opaque indigo panels clean up every native widget, the wallpaper drifts like a film exposure, and Ambient pairs a large clock with a live monthly calendar. Accent colours stay user-customizable.
entries.changelog: 1.0.0: semantic dark theme, animated long-exposure city wallpaper and calendar Ambient scene.

entries.name: Daybook
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A local timecard for your workday. Daybook records the foreground app in 15-second slots, turns the day into a punched activity tape, and keeps focus sessions in the topbar. No account or network.

entries.name: Docker Container Stats Display
entries.author: Swiv
entries.description:
Displays Memory and CPU Usage by individal Docker Containers via Glances API found here - github.com/nicolargo/glances
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    container_name: glances
    restart: unless-stopped
    pids_limit: 200
    ports:
      - "61208:61208"
    volumes:
      -

entries.name: DGM league table
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Clasificación is a responsive football standings widget for Xenon. It displays league tables with position, matches played, goal difference and points across supported competitions, with Spanish and English interfaces, multi-provider fallback and clear unavailable-data states.
entries.changelog: Improved initial loading and Xenon 4.9 compatibility, with safer credential restoration, visibility-aware fetching and a single coordinated startup load.

entries.name: DGM Results
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Resultados is a responsive football results widget for Xenon. It displays live and recent scores, fixtures, competition details and match status in a clean bilingual interface, with clear loading, empty and unavailable-data states.
entries.changelog: Finalized the stable 0.5.4 release candidate and completed live QA, stability and export validation.

entries.name: Mixer
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: Console mixer: un fader per ogni app che suona, piu' il master. Trascina per regolare, tocca l'icona per mutare, salva e richiama scene. La scala mostra l'uscita reale (app x master), non il segnale.

entries.name: Prayer Times
entries.author: aabdelghani
entries.description: The five daily prayers plus sunrise, with a live countdown to the next one. Times are computed on your PC from the sun's position, so there is no account, no API key and no service to go down: it works offline. Nine calculation authorities, both Asr schools, per-prayer fine-tuning.

entries.name: DGM Air Quality
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Air Quality shows the European Air Quality Index and concentrations of PM2.5, PM10, ozone and nitrogen dioxide for the city shared by DGM Current Weather. It uses Open-Meteo, supports Spanish and English, and pauses network activity when the widget is not visible.
entries.changelog: Improved Xenon visibility handling, pausing updates while the widget is off-page or hidden and retaining compatibility with older hosts.

entries.name: DGM Current weather
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Current Weather shows temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity, wind and precipitation for a manually selected city. It supports metric and imperial units, Spanish and English, shares its location with other DGM Weather widgets and uses Open-Meteo.
entries.changelog: Improved Xenon visibility handling, pausing weather requests while the widget is off-page or hidden and retaining compatibility with older hosts.

entries.name: DGM 7-Day Forecast
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM 7-Day Forecast shows daily high and low temperatures, precipitation and wind for the next seven days. It uses the city shared by DGM Current Weather, supports metric and imperial units plus Spanish and English, and retrieves data from Open-Meteo.
entries.changelog: Improved Xenon visibility handling, pausing forecast requests while the widget is off-page or hidden and retaining compatibility with older hosts.

entries.name: DGM weather radar
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Weather Radar displays the latest available RainViewer precipitation layer for the city configured in DGM Current Weather. It supports panning, zooming, recentering and refresh controls, uses Leaflet and CARTO maps, and pauses activity when the widget is not visible.
entries.changelog: Improved Xenon visibility handling and radar lifecycle, including safer pause and resume behavior and refined regional zoom support.

entries.name: Keyring
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: Encrypted 2FA codes and passwords in one place. Codes stay on screen by your keyboard with a countdown ring; the code for a focused desktop app floats to the top. Copying a password needs a tap you confirm. Everything is encrypted on this PC, with no cloud and no recovery.

entries.name: Thermal Card
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: CPU and GPU temperature, VRAM and RAM in one card. Tap any row to swap which value leads, and pick which monitors you want. Reads sensors only, with no actions and no network.

entries.name: Forest
entries.author: Domi / spamer7777-lgtm
entries.description: Dimmly lit forest with fireflies flying around

entries.name: DGM News Sports
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM News Sports delivers balanced sports headlines from Marca, AS, Mundo Deportivo, BBC Sport, The Guardian and ESPN. It offers Spanish and English interfaces, compact thumbnails, source rotation and clear loading, partial and error states through Xenon’s official SDK.
entries.changelog: Updated the runtime for Xenon 4.9+, improving cold start, visibility-aware refresh, thumbnail loading, image toggling and retry behavior.

entries.name: DGM News Technology
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM News Technology delivers balanced technology headlines from Xataka, Hipertextual, Microsiervos, BBC Technology, The Guardian and Ars Technica. It offers Spanish and English interfaces, compact thumbnails, source rotation and clear loading, partial and error states.
entries.changelog: Updated the runtime for Xenon 4.9+, improving cold start, visibility-aware refresh, thumbnail loading, image toggling and retry behavior.

entries.name: Map Explorer
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM Map Explorer is a responsive visual catalogue for opening external video game maps from Xenon. It includes built-in games, persistent custom entries, favorites and recent items, optional session-only images, and safe opening through Xenon Browser with a controlled system-browser fallback.
entries.changelog: Added persistent custom map entries, optional session-only images, Xenon Browser opening, improved visibility handling and a responsive custom-card layout.

entries.name: DGM News General
entries.author: DanielGarciaMorato
entries.description: DGM News General delivers balanced headlines from El Mundo, El País, BBC News, The Guardian, The New York Times and Le Monde. It offers Spanish and English interfaces, compact thumbnails, source rotation and clear loading, partial and error states through Xenon’s official SDK.
entries.changelog: Updated the runtime for Xenon 4.9+, improving cold start, visibility-aware refresh, thumbnail loading, image toggling and retry behavior.

entries.name: VANGUARD 50 // VOICE RELAY
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A Discord voice console with live session telemetry, set in an observatory night sky with an obsidian Deck. 50 copies, each carrying its own serial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord.

entries.name: POW! — Comic Book Pack
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: An exclusive comic-book universe for the Xeneon Edge, for supporters only. A living hand-inked skyline shifts with the real weather and time of day, doubling as a screensaver, alongside comic System, Fans, Batteries and Energy boards and a hand-drawn Sidekick Deck. Six artifacts, one code.

entries.name: Ambra
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A warm, minimal pack: an amber theme on deep espresso with the animated 'Bruma d'Ambra' background, a redesigned weather widget (temperature-forward, with an essential hourly strip) and an Ambient screensaver showing clock and weather.

entries.name: Teleprompter
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: Write a script, then read it like a pro: large auto-scrolling prompter text with the current sentence lit, a 3-2-1 countdown, drag-to-scrub, 0.5×–3× speed and a live time-remaining estimate. Keep a library of named scripts, drop [2s] anywhere to pause, and mirror it for prompter glass.

entries.name: NØVA // NEON DISTRICT
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: A limited cyberpunk drop: a neon duotone theme, the animated Megacity Drift background with a holographic whale, the Orbitron display font, three bespoke widgets (Vitals rings, Now Playing, Skynode weather), an Ambient scene and a Deck profile. Reserved on Discord: each buyer gets a personal access

entries.name: Ember Nights
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: Warm amber accent over a deep charcoal glass, a cozy evening look for the Edge.

entries.name: Deep Ocean
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: Cool cyan on abyssal navy: calm, high-contrast and easy on the eyes at night.

entries.name: Silk Waves
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: Slow flowing wave lines over a midnight gradient, an animated backdrop that stays out of the way.

entries.name: Nocturne
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: A quiet late-night look: sage-teal accent over deep charcoal-navy glass, with a soft drifting backdrop baked in. Calm and easy on the eyes after dark.

entries.name: Nocturne Drift
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: A calm animated backdrop: slow sage glows drifting over a near-black wash with a faint twinkling starfield. Bounded and quiet, it stays out of the way.

entries.name: Nocturne Control
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: An eight-key Deck profile for everyday control: media transport, mic mute, volume up or down, a 25-minute focus timer and a volume fader. Portable across machines.

entries.name: Nocturne Now Playing
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: A now-playing player: the album cover fills the tile behind the track, artist, a progress bar and play/pause, previous and next controls. Follows your theme accent. Needs media access and control.

entries.name: Nocturne Hours
entries.author: Xenon
entries.description: A calm fullscreen clock for Ambient mode: big time, the date and one slow breathing glow on a dim OLED-friendly background. Requests no permissions.

entries.name: Nocturne Pack
entries.author: xenon
entries.description: The whole Nocturne look in one install: the theme with its drifting backdrop, the now-playing widget, the ambient clock scene, the Deck profile and the desk page.

entries.name: Tranquility
entries.author: spamer7777-lgtm
entries.description: A serene Himalayan lake at golden hour: a temple, prayer flags and a boat, with drifting clouds, fireflies and shimmering water layered on top.

entries.name: Cats
entries.author: spamer7777-lgtm
entries.description: A cozy pastel room full of adorable cats, with floating hearts and soft sparkles drifting over the scene. Cute and sweet.

entries.name: Sakura
entries.author: spamer7777-lgtm
entries.description: A pink cherry-blossom look over deep plum glass. Its backdrop is a hand-painted Japanese scene (temple, torii and a coiling dragon) with sakura petals, drifting light rays and glowing lanterns animating gently on top.
